# Determining biodiversity

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

idmaker <- function(x)
  {
    max.val = x*100
    count <- nchar(as.character(max.val))                       # find out how many 'numbers' each ID will have after the letter
    size <- paste("%0",count,"d",sep="")                        # set the variable to be fed into 'sprintf' to ensure we have leading 0's
    lets <- toupper(sample(letters,x, replace=T))               # randomising the letters 
    nums <- sprintf(size,sample(1:max.val)[1:x])                # randominsing the numbers, and ensuing they all have the same number of characters
    ids <- paste(lets,nums,sep="")                              # joining them together
  return(ids)
  }
```

```{r}
n_species <- 100
n_per_species <- 100
ids <- idmaker(n_species)
population <- rep(ids, n_per_species)
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(abind)

# 1. Define simulation parameters
set.seed(123)
n_sites <- 50          # Number of differing communities/sites
n_surveys <- 3         # Repeated visits per site
n_species <- 10        # Number of species in the community pool

# True occupancy probability (psi) varying by community/species
# Higher values in Community Type A vs Community Type B
community_type <- rep(c("TypeA", "TypeB"), each = 25)
psi_mean <- ifelse(community_type == "TypeA", 0.7, 0.3)

# 2. Simulate true presence/absence (Z) for each site and species
Z <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_sites, ncol = n_species)
for (i in 1:n_sites) {
  for (j in 1:n_species) {
    Z[i, j] <- rbinom(1, 1, prob = psi_mean[i])
  }
}

# 3. Simulate observed detection (Y) accounting for imperfect detection (p)
p_detect <- 0.45 # Average detection probability
Y <- array(0, dim = c(n_sites, n_surveys, n_species))

for (i in 1:n_sites) {
  for (k in 1:n_surveys) {
    for (j in 1:n_species) {
      # Detection only possible if species is truly present (Z[i,j] == 1)
      Y[i, k, j] <- rbinom(1, 1, prob = Z[i, j] * p_detect)
    }
  }
}

# Summary of simulated detection history
cat("Total detections recorded:", sum(Y), "\n")
cat("Dimensions of detection array [Sites, Surveys, Species]:", dim(Y), "\n")
```
